subject: pharmacology
title: Pituitary drugs: GH, desmopressin, oxytocin and dopaminergics

steps.tx: **Growth hormone** (somatropin, IGF-1 mediated growth, glucose antagonism) treats documented deficiency (stimulation tests, short stature with delayed bone age) and Turner, CKD and SGA short stature; excess causes acromegaly (octreotide, pegvisomant, surgery per endocrine wave). Side effects (intracranial hypertension, slipped epiphysis, glucose intolerance) watch; athletics abuse (acromegalic features, cardiomyopathy) bans. IGF-1 with growth velocity follows.
steps.say: Short delayed bone age low IGF-1 is GH deficiency: replace and watch velocity. Slipped epiphysis headaches warn.

steps.tx: **Desmopressin** (V2 selective, no pressor V1) treats **central diabetes insipidus** (thirsty polyuria with dilute urine, water deprivation plus copeptin sorting central from nephrogenic), **bedwetting** (nocturnal enuresis second line), and **mild haemophilia A with von Willebrand disease** (endothelial vWF release, tachyphylaxis). **Hyponatraemia** (nasal overabsorption, elderly) restricts fluids; nephrogenic DI (lithium, hypercalcaemia) instead gets thiazides with amiloride. Desmopressin challenge distinguishes.
steps.say: Dilute thirsty polyuria concentrating on desmopressin is central DI. Bedwetters and mild haemophilics benefit; sodium watched.

steps.tx: **Oxytocin** (labour **induction and augmentation**, **PPH prevention** and treatment, milk letdown) is titrated by contraction monitoring (hyperstimulation with fetal distress eases off, fluids restrict into hyponatraemia); **ergometrine** (sustained tetany, hypertension ban, retained placenta) and **carboprost** (asthma ban, diarrhoea) rescue atonic bleeding with **misoprostol** (shivering, sublingual PPH where cold chain fails). Active third stage (oxytocin with controlled traction) prevents most PPH.
steps.say: Atonic PPH gets oxytocin first, ergometrine if pressure allows, carboprost if breathing allows. Hyperstimulated uterus rests off drip.

steps.tx: **Dopamine agonists** (**bromocriptine, cabergoline**: prolactinoma shrinkers per pituitary wave, acromegaly adjuncts, Parkinson add-ons) risk **valvulopathy** (high dose Parkinson range, echo watched) with impulse control disorders; **tocolytics** (nifedipine first line preterm labour, **atosiban** oxytocin antagonist, **MgSO4** neuroprotection with toxicity watched: reflexes, respirations, urine output, **calcium rescue**, indomethacin ductus caution) buy steroids time. **Magnesium eclampsia** (Pritchard, seizure recurrence) monitors similarly.
steps.say: Preterm contractions buy steroids with nifedipine; fetal brain gains MgSO4. Lost reflexes on magnesium is toxicity: calcium.
